decisions.summary: All Blue Harbor Foods reefer imports will be routed for customs clearance via Kim & Park Customs Services' Busan office only, effective Q2 2026.

tasks.summary: Ensure the import team applies the Kim & Park Busan-only routing to all Blue Harbor Foods reefer files.
Include the Blue Harbor reefer Kim & Park Busan routing in the handover from Jiwoo Han to Daniel Cho before Jiwoo leaves on 2026-06-30.

deadlines.what: Jiwoo Han leaves; handover of Blue Harbor reefer routing to Daniel Cho must be completed.
